caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: Martinique
caribbean.paragraph: Martinique in the Lesser Antilles is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 13 kt and seas building to 2.8 ft with SE swell at 6s periods. 100% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 24 kt and seas building to 6.8 ft with SW swell at 6s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
